Thanks — I want to lock this by Tuesday so we don’t ship an incorrect VOD policy.

All — technical note and test plan:

1) RTMP / ingest info: on24-ops, please confirm which ingest host we should publish to for the Sept 8 sweep. If ON24 wants to host the encoder session we’ll use the same stream key as the live event.

2) Latency sweep plan (Sept 8) — 14:00–14:30 PDT
- 14:00–14:05: baseline tone + timestamp overlay (we’ll record locally and on the platform)
- 14:05–14:15: simulated slides + audio; measure end‑to‑end audio offset across EU/US test endpoints
- 14:15–14:25: captioning passthrough test (SRT) with vendor feed; confirm track labeling (eng/fr)
- 14:25–14:30: failover test (switch RTMP to backup encoder)

3) Measurements: I’ll capture per-region RTT and audio offset in latency-test-results.csv and post after the sweep. Please ensure the following ports are open in your encoder network: 1935/TCP (RTMP), 554/TCP or 8554 (RTSP if used), 80/443 for HLS fetches.

4) Access: Naomi, can you confirm on24 has the VOD asset-level geoblocking capability? If not, we’ll gate access with a redirect based on Geo-IP at the registration page.

Attachments: latency-test-results.csv (placeholder — will be updated after the run)

Thanks — I’ll build the checklist into the runbook doc in Drive once we have the ingest host.

—Ben
